analysis: Documentation-only changes. hardware-support.md head 446-881 (unit 5/6) contains no changed lines per range map (changes at head 3 and 371-408, not in these units); content describes memory ledger, KV grants, calibration and Flint bounds, unchanged here. model-autopilot.md patch (head 151, 175-212, 278-281, 293-297) documents a new selected-model recovery policy: queued reload of operator-selected models unloaded by Autopilot operations, eviction of unheld adopted slots under victim rules (min_dwell, leases, idle >= max(2 min, min_idle_seconds)), and adoption release ten minutes after hold expiry/waiting start; released model refuses new requests as model_not_selected while in-flight requests finish. Security relevance: A-018/TB-012/T-059 availability — doc states add-on hold pauses recovery and cancels in-progress attempts (enterAddonHold), and recovery is busy as preload so operations are refused; this aligns with T-059 model-load fence if implemented. No change to attestation, encryption, A-001 data paths, T-041 cache, billing or authorization. The recovery policy is provider-local residency; it is operator-favoring (operator controls enabled_models anyway, ADV-001 already controls residency), so no new adversarial capability visible. Integration should verify in source (ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift, ProviderLoop+SelectedModelPlacementPolicy.swift) that recovery loads respect the add-on hold model-load fence (T-059), in-flight requests for released adoptions retire cleanly without cancellation leaks, and that 'policy pending owner review' note is not a shipped unreviewed behavior change affecting coordinator routing contracts (model_not_selected for adopted model). Source not supplied; no regression identified from docs alone.
